From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: Ficken

German

Alternative forms

  • f*ck*n, f*cken (censored)

Etymology

From Middle High German ficken (“to rub, solidify, strengthen”), perhaps from Old High German *fuchōn, *fuhhōn (attested in fitafuchōn, fitafuhhōn (“to yearn for, seek or solicit fornication”), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *pewǵ- (“to stick, sting, stab”). The interjectional use is probably a semantic loan from English fuck.

Alternatively, perhaps related to Middle Low German vicken, ficken (“to beat, chastise, punish by beating”), whence German Low German ficken; compare also Middle Dutch bevicken (“to hit, strike”).

  • IPA(key): /ˈfɪkən/, [ˈfɪkən], [ˈfɪkŋ̩]

  • Rhymes: -ɪkən

Verb

ficken (weak, third-person singular present fickt, past tense fickte, past participle gefickt, auxiliary haben)

  1. (vulgar, transitive or intransitive) to fuck
    • [18th-20th c., uncertain (ascribed to Friedrich Schlegel or Alexander Bessmertny), Erotische Sonette:
      Wie klug mein Rat: ich schiebe meinen Dicken
      In dein bemoostes Tor – man nennt das Ficken.
      So wise my advice: I shove my girth
      Into your mossy door - that's what they call fucking.      ]
    • 2004, “Fickt das System”, in Wichtig, performed by Die Sterne:
      Nach der Revolution totale Freiheit / Du kannst ficken wen du willst, was willst du denn?
      After the revolution total freedom / You can fuck whoever you want, so what do you want?
  2. (obsolete) to rub; slide

Interjection

ficken!

  1. (vulgar, uncommon) fuck!
    Ach, ficken! Jetz’ hab ich meine Jacke vergessen.
    Ah, fuck! Now I forgot to take my jacket.
    • 2000 August 21, [FFL]Troj (Ralf Schick), “Die Welt der Quaker !”, in de.alt.games.quake‎[1] (Usenet):
      > schoen das Du Dich jetzt auch traust, Deinen Wohnort bekannt zu geben.
      > NUR, Du stehst schon lange drinn !!! :)
      Ach ficken mann :)
      > nice that you're finally brave enough to announce your address.
      > ONLY, your name's been in [the list of people's hometowns] for a long time !!! :)
      Ah fuck dude :)
    • 2001 December 11, Basar Alabay, “Mail von Basar (fwd)”, in de.soc.subkultur.gothic‎[2] (Usenet):
      Ficken ey, morgen ist Mittwoch. Mannmannmann, ich hätte das ganze über IRC abwickeln sollen.
      Fuck man, tomorrow is Wednesday. Ugh, god, I should've done the whole thing via IRC.
    • 2009 June 19, Eften, “haltepratzen schweißen.”, in simsonforum.de‎[3], archived from the original on 17 November 2025:
      boah ficken! war da wenig fleisch aber wird wohl bis nächste woche halten.
      ugh, fuck! not a lot of meat there but itll probably last until next week.
    • 2014, Olle Wolf, Fümnzwanzich‎[4], →ISBN:
      Dann glücklich sein, Familie gründen, Kinder machen, Auto kaufen, Karriere durchstarten, Haus bauen. Baum pflanzen. Alter, wie derbe das aufeinander aufbaut. Ficken, ey. Wie soll man das alles bewältigen?
      Then, be happy, start a family, have some children, buy a car, jumpstart your career, build a house. Plant a tree. Dude, the fucking way it all builds on top of each other. Fuck, man. How are you supposed to manage to do all of that?
    • 2025, Julia Engelmann, Himmel ohne Ende, Diogenes Verlag AG, →ISBN:
      »Meine Mom zwingt mich, jedes verfickte Silvester auf Konni aufzupassen. Wegen seiner Schwester. Die hätte morgen Geburtstag. Erster Erster.« Er nahm einen Zug von Pommes' Zigarette und prustete. »Ach, ficken.«
      "My mom is making me take care of Konni every fucking New Year's Eve. Because of his sister. Her birthday would have been tomorrow. First of January." He took a drag from Pommes's cigarette and snorted. "Ugh, fuck."
